meta.title: Leisure centres tubes
meta.description: Aluminium wire fin on tube for automotive heat exchangers, where cost, mass and packing constraints drive fuel efficiency, performance and emissions.

automotive.title: Leisure centres tubes
automotive.lede: The automotive market for heat pumps has a different set of requirements from other industries. Cost, mass and packing constraints are key drivers, as they affect the fuel efficiency, performance and emissions of the vehicle.
automotive.heading: Why aluminium wire fin
paragraphs: Aluminium wire fin on tube meets all three constraints: a high heat transfer coefficient, low weight and a compact design. Fins can be added to long lengths of tube without joints, so the heat pump becomes part of the fluid line, with fewer fittings and potential leak points.

Wire fin works well in confused air flow, as thermal performance is not hindered. The wire fins create turbulence, enhancing heat transfer and reducing air-side pressure drop. They also suit high pressure applications, as applying the fin does not affect the mechanical integrity of the tubing.

Aluminium is the most common fin and tube material, with high thermal conductivity, good corrosion resistance and low cost. Stainless steel and plated carbon steel tubing can be used where extra strength or durability is needed. A range of tube diameters and fin configurations is available, and we can customise shape, size and layout to fit the available space.
bullets: High efficiency wire fin design (aluminium or copper)
Finning applied directly onto the tube, so it can be part of the fluid line
No intermediate joints required
Withstands high pressures (limited by the base tube)
Aluminium, plated carbon steel and stainless steel
Supplied straight or bent, end formed or plain tube
